title: Manuelle Ausnahme-Freigabe eines geflaggten Prompts
description: As a security admin, I want to release a flagged prompt with a documented reason, so that false positives do not block my teams.

acceptance_criteria.given: a version is FLAGGED with a finding of severity HIGH
acceptance_criteria.when: the security admin releases it with a reason
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and the version reaches status WAIVED
and: the audit trail records actor, timestamp and reason
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-023-waiver.feature: The security admin releases a flagged version with a reason

acceptance_criteria.when: a developer attempts to release it
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 403 and the status stays FLAGGED
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-023-waiver.feature: A developer cannot release a flagged version

acceptance_criteria.when: the security admin submits a release without a reason
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 422 and the status stays FLAGGED
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-023-waiver.feature: A release without a reason is rejected
